proof_origin.place: Morphism equality induction, avoiding equality comparison of whole derived functors.

title: Morphism-indexed pullback equality transport
statement: For an ambient proper/open calculus c [def-sf-ambient-proper-open-calculus] and an equality h:f=g of scheme-indexing morphisms, define morphismPullbackCongr c h:c.P(f)≅c.P(g) by equality induction on h, with identity isomorphism in the reflexive case. It agrees with the prescribed c.pCongr h, which transports along congrArg c.P h.

source.place: Composition coherence: equality transport of the pullback index; Stacks 03CB.

proof.text: Eliminate h at the level of indexing morphisms. In the reflexive case the pullback functors are the same and Iso.refl constructs the required natural isomorphism. To compare with pCongr, eliminate h again; both constructions reduce to Iso.refl. Thus every component is exactly the specified equality transport, including identity maps and empty schemes.

from.place: Equality transport in the composition clause.
